scope: Only newly authorized matchup-breakdown route; no Home/Steelers/Team Details code edits.
decoration: Native SVG full chamfered panel perimeter, CSS opacity glints/breathing, low-opacity transform/opacity stadium reflections, native endpoint diamond scintillation. Every injected node is aria-hidden and pointer-events:none.
lifecycle: Native reduced-motion CSS stops infinite hardware animation.
Actual clipping rectangles and native intersection/resize observers pause offscreen zones.
Native observed route/render DOM events reconcile changing frame sizes; unchanged dataset retains clock identity.
Empty nav is deliberately left undecorated until real controls exist.
performance: No JS requestAnimationFrame animation loop or interval in motion module.
No clock seeking, virtual time, image upscaling, per-frame JS layout writes or interpolated facts.
All motion is native CSS; opacity/transform reflections and small SVG stroke dashoffset travelling highlights.
Mutation observer watches only childList/class/hidden; no self-triggering observation of its own data-state/viewBox/path updates.
Disconnected zones and stale animation references are pruned after rerender.
qualification: Inventory is not visual acceptance or physical mobile/FPS certification. Actual browser motion, input and screenshot review receipts are required separately.
